MERGE INTO TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO tbms USING ( select
#{settleSeqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} settleSeqNo,
#{settleStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} settleStatus,
#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} tradeId,
#{settleDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} settleDate,
#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} finprodId,
#{settleNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} settleNum,
#{settleAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} settleAmt,
#{busiType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} busiType,
#{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} createUser,
#{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} createDept,
#{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} createTime,
#{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} updateUser,
#{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} updateTime
from dual ) TEMP
ON (tbms.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = TEMP.settleSeqNo)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
tbms.SETTLE_STATUS = TEMP.settleStatus,
tbms.TRADE_ID = TEMP.tradeId,
tbms.SETTLE_DATE = TEMP.settleDate,
tbms.FINPROD_ID = TEMP.finprodId,
tbms.SETTLE_NUM = TEMP.settleNum,
tbms.SETTLE_AMT = TEMP.settleAmt,
tbms.BUSI_TYPE = TEMP.busiType,
tbms.CREATE_USER = TEMP.createUser,
tbms.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.createDept,
tbms.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.createTime,
tbms.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.updateUser,
tbms.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.updateTime
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
SETTLE_SEQ_NO
,SETTLE_STATUS
,TRADE_ID
,SETTLE_DATE
,FINPROD_ID
,SETTLE_NUM
,SETTLE_AMT
,BUSI_TYPE
,CREATE_USER
,CREATE_DEPT
,CREATE_TIME
,UPDATE_USER
,UPDATE_TIME
) values(
TEMP.settleSeqNo
,TEMP.settleStatus
,TEMP.tradeId
,TEMP.settleDate
,TEMP.finprodId
,TEMP.settleNum
,TEMP.settleAmt
,TEMP.busiType
,TEMP.createUser
,TEMP.createDept
,TEMP.createTime
,TEMP.updateUser
,TEMP.updateTime
)
mapper.select: SELECT TPD.TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, BUSI_TYPE BUSI_TYPE, FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH BRANCH, TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE, VDATE VDATE, MDATE MDATE, SETTLE_DATE SETTLE_DATE, SETTLE_SPEED SETTLE_SPEED, CCY CCY, CPRICE_DATE CPRICE_DATE, UNIT_CPRICE UNIT_CPRICE, UNIT_INT UNIT_INT, UNIT_FPRICE UNIT_FPRICE, PAR_VALUE PAR_VALUE, CPRICE_AMT CPRICE_AMT, case when TPD.PS != 'T07' and (FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F02' or FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F03') then SHARE_AMT WHEN FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN SHARE_AMT * 100 else SHARE_AMT end SHARE_AMT, PRIN_AMT PRIN_AMT, INT_AMT INT_AMT, FPRICE_AMT FPRICE_AMT, FEE_AMT_PAY FEE_AMT_PAY, TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT, FEE_AMT_UNPAY FEE_AMT_UNPAY, FEE_AMT FEE_AMT, PS PS, YIELD YIELD, EXER_YIELD EXER_YIELD, INV_AIM INV_AIM, TRADE_STATUS TRADE_STATUS, IS_CANCEL IS_CANCEL, P_TRADE_ID P_TRADE_ID, IS_CLEAN IS_CLEAN, TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID TOTLE_TRADE_ID, R_TRADE_ID R_TRADE_ID, B_TRADE_ID B_TRADE_ID, CHL_ID CHL_ID, COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, IS_OUT_TRADE IS_OUT_TRADE, TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_PLAT TRADE_PLAT, TRADE_MARKET_MODE TRADE_MARKET_MODE, TRADER TRADER, COUNTER_TRADER COUNTER_TRADER, COUNTER_CONTACT COUNTER_CONTACT, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, F_TRADE_ID F_TRADE_ID, CASH_ID CASH_ID, REGIST_ORG REGIST_ORG, REMARK REMARK, CANCEL_REMARK CANCEL_REMARK, DELIVERY_TYPE DELIVERY_TYPE, PAY_DATE PAY_DATE, SALE_CODE SALE_CODE, ACCR_NUM ACCR_NUM, TG_BUSI_TYPE TG_BUSI_TYPE, PS_PAYMENT PS_PAYMENT, SEAT_ID SEAT_ID, SETTLEMEN_TYPE SETTLEMEN_TYPE, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, TPDA.OUR_SHARE_AMT, TPDA.LENDIN_SHARE_AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT TPD.TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, BUSI_TYPE BUSI_TYPE, FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH BRANCH, TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE, VDATE VDATE, MDATE MDATE, SETTLE_DATE SETTLE_DATE, SETTLE_SPEED SETTLE_SPEED, CCY CCY, CPRICE_DATE CPRICE_DATE, UNIT_CPRICE UNIT_CPRICE, UNIT_INT UNIT_INT, UNIT_FPRICE UNIT_FPRICE, PAR_VALUE PAR_VALUE, CPRICE_AMT CPRICE_AMT, case when TPD.PS != 'T07' and (FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F02' or FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F03') then SHARE_AMT when TPD.PS = 'T07' and (FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F02' or FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F03') then SHARE_AMT* 100 WHEN FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN SHARE_AMT * 100 else SHARE_AMT end SHARE_AMT, PRIN_AMT PRIN_AMT, INT_AMT INT_AMT, FPRICE_AMT FPRICE_AMT, FEE_AMT_PAY FEE_AMT_PAY, TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT, FEE_AMT_UNPAY FEE_AMT_UNPAY, FEE_AMT FEE_AMT, PS PS, YIELD YIELD, EXER_YIELD EXER_YIELD, INV_AIM INV_AIM, TRADE_STATUS TRADE_STATUS, IS_CANCEL IS_CANCEL, P_TRADE_ID P_TRADE_ID, IS_CLEAN IS_CLEAN, TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID TOTLE_TRADE_ID, R_TRADE_ID R_TRADE_ID, B_TRADE_ID B_TRADE_ID, CHL_ID CHL_ID, COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, IS_OUT_TRADE IS_OUT_TRADE, TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_PLAT TRADE_PLAT, TRADE_MARKET_MODE TRADE_MARKET_MODE, TRADER TRADER, COUNTER_TRADER COUNTER_TRADER, COUNTER_CONTACT COUNTER_CONTACT, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, F_TRADE_ID F_TRADE_ID, CASH_ID CASH_ID, REGIST_ORG REGIST_ORG, REMARK REMARK, CANCEL_REMARK CANCEL_REMARK, DELIVERY_TYPE DELIVERY_TYPE, PAY_DATE PAY_DATE, SALE_CODE SALE_CODE, ACCR_NUM ACCR_NUM, TG_BUSI_TYPE TG_BUSI_TYPE, PS_PAYMENT PS_PAYMENT, SEAT_ID SEAT_ID, SETTLEMEN_TYPE SETTLEMEN_TYPE, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, TPDA.OUR_SHARE_AMT, TPDA.LENDIN_SHARE_AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS ='01'

SELECT regdeal.TRADE_ID FROM REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL regdeal LEFT JOIN REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL regtotal ON regdeal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = regtotal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRDQUTO_MATCH_INFO matchinfo ON matchinfo.PRE_TRADE_ID = regtotal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL total ON total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = matchinfo.TRD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal ON deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dealadd ON dealadd.TRADE_ID = deal.TRADE_ID AND dealadd.ENTRUST_ID = regdeal.ENTRUST_ID WHERE deal.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT iqer.QUOTE_ID FROM IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE iqer LEFT JOIN IBU_QUOTE_BOND iqb ON iqb.QUOTE_ID = iqer.QUOTE_ID LEFT JOIN TRDQUTO_MATCH_INFO matchinfo ON iqb.QUOTE_ID = matchinfo.PRE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL total ON total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = matchinfo.TRD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal ON deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dealadd ON dealadd.TRADE_ID = deal.TRADE_ID AND dealadd.ENTRUST_ID = iqer.ENTRUST_ID WHERE deal.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId1}

SELECT iqc.QUOTE_ID TRADE_ID FROM IBU_QUOTE_CREP iqc LEFT JOIN TRDQUTO_MATCH_INFO matchinfo ON matchinfo.PRE_TRADE_ID = iqc.QUOTE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL total ON total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = matchinfo.TRD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal ON deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE deal.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select reg.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID as finprodId,reg.PLEDGE_RATIO as pledgeRatio, reg.PLEDGE_NUMBER as pledgePrin from FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE reg where reg.finprod_id =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT iqb.FINPROD_ID finprodId, deal.INV_AIM invAim, iqb.SETT_CCY ccy, iqb.PS ps, iqb.SETTLE_DATE settleDate, iqer.QUOTE_ID tradeId, iqer.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, iqer.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, iqer.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, iqer.FPRICE_AMT tradeAmt, iqer.CREATE_USER createUser, iqer.CREATE_DEPT createDept
FROM IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE iqer LEFT JOIN IBU_QUOTE_BOND iqb ON iqb.QUOTE_ID = iqer.QUOTE_ID LEFT JOIN TRDQUTO_MATCH_INFO matchinfo ON iqb.QUOTE_ID = matchinfo.PRE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL total ON total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = matchinfo.TRD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal ON deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dealadd ON dealadd.TRADE_ID = deal.TRADE_ID AND dealadd.ENTRUST_ID = iqer.ENTRUST_ID WHERE iqer.QUOTE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT T.finprodId, T.finprodMarketId, T.finprodAbbr, T.portfolioId, T.portfolioName, SUM(pledgePrin) pledgePrin, T.pledgeRate, T.firstNetPrice, T.repRegistOrg FROM ( select rp.pledge_finprod_id as finprodId, nvl(fp.finprod_market_id, ipo.SECID) AS finprodMarketId, nvl(fp.finprod_abbr, ipo.SECNAME) AS finprodAbbr, tpda.portfolio_id as portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name as portfolioName, (rp.pledge_number * rp.pledge_ratio) / 100 as pledgePrin, rp.pledge_ratio * 100 as pledgeRate, mbvi.NETPRICE as firstNetPrice, nvl(fp.REGIST_ORG, ipo.INSTITUTION) AS repRegistOrg from FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE rp left join trd_product_deal deal on rp.finprod_id = deal.trade_id left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id = rp.pledge_finprod_id LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO ipo ON ipo.SECID = rp.pledge_finprod_id left join trd_product_deal_add tpda on tpda.trade_id = rp.finprod_id LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID, T2.PRICE, T2.NETPRICE FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID, tmp1.value_source, MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND tmp1.value_date <= to_date(#{platDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*估值行情.日期 小于等于 平台日*/ AND tmp1.value_source = ( CASE WHEN tmp2.trade_market IN (#{TRADEPLACE03}, #{TRADEPLACE04}) THEN 'CSD' ELSE 'CBC' END) GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id, tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) mbvi/*以上获取债券小于等于平台日的最新估值行情*/ ON fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = mbvi.SEC_ID where deal.trade_id = #{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) T GROUP BY T.finprodId, T.finprodMarketId, T.finprodAbbr, T.portfolioId, T.portfolioName, T.pledgeRate, T.firstNetPrice, T.repRegistOrg
